mapper.select: select id, name, password, email_id as "emailId", email_domain as "emailDomain", tel1, tel2, tel3, post, basic_addr as "basicAddr", detail_addr as "detailAddr", type, to_char(reg_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as "regDate" from tbl_member order by reg_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into tbl_member(id, name, password, email_id, email_domain, tel1, tel2, tel3, post, basic_addr, detail_addr, type) / values(#{id}, #{name}, #{password}, #{emailId}, #{emailDomain}, #{tel1}, #{tel2}, #{tel3}, #{post}, #{basicAddr}, #{detailAddr}, #{type})
mapper.select: select id, name, password, email_id as "emailId", email_domain as "emailDomain", tel1, tel2, tel3, post, basic_addr as "basicAddr", detail_addr as "detailAddr", type, to_char(reg_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as "regDate" from tbl_member where id = #{id} order by reg_date desc
